sentences.en: We began to see what we can deduce from it.
sentences.zh: 我们开始看出可以从它推断出什么。

sentences.en: Sherlock Holmes could deduce much out of the smallest details.
sentences.zh: 夏洛克·福尔摩斯可以从微小的细节中推理出很多东西。

sentences.en: "How in the world did you deduce that?" I asked.
sentences.zh: ‘你是怎么得出这个结论的？’我问道。
